string.text: Reusable QA item for double-click or a quick-use slot. Finds the nearest existing stash and writes its coordinates to the catalogue rejection log. Log: $app_data_root$\logs\pf_stash_qa_catalog_rejections.log.

Reusable QA item. Native use — double-click or a quick-use slot — records and deletes the stash directly under the crosshair. Its context action marks the nearest stash in the rejection log without deleting it. A missed target or log error leaves the object untouched. Log: $app_data_root$\logs\pf_stash_qa_catalog_rejections.log.
Reusable QA item for double-click or a quick-use slot. Teleports the actor to the next stash in the shared non-repeating queue.

Reusable QA item for double-click or a quick-use slot. Shows all 350 active coordinates in their tier colours without rolling loot or changing stash state. Use it again to remove the QA previews. Equivalent to Num 0.

Separate reusable QA item. Shows the entire canonical stash-coordinate catalogue on the PDA: currently 971 points, including the 350 selected locations and the free reserve. Yellow markers are built gradually, create no containers or loot, and never change stash state. Use it again to hide every catalogue marker.

Reusable QA item for double-click or a quick-use slot. Places a test backpack at the crosshair. Logs: $app_data_root$\logs\pf_stash_qa_placements.log and $app_data_root$\logs\pf_stash_qa_patterns.log. Equivalent to Num 1.

Reusable QA item for double-click or a quick-use slot. Deletes the test backpack under the crosshair and removes its rows from $app_data_root$\logs\pf_stash_qa_placements.log and $app_data_root$\logs\pf_stash_qa_patterns.log. Equivalent to Num Del.

Reusable QA item for double-click or a quick-use slot. Undoes the latest test-backpack placement and removes it from $app_data_root$\logs\pf_stash_qa_placements.log and $app_data_root$\logs\pf_stash_qa_patterns.log. Equivalent to Num +.
Reusable QA item for double-click or a quick-use slot. Records the crosshair point as a future light-source candidate. Log: $app_data_root$\logs\pf_bunker_qa_light_points.log.
Reusable QA item for double-click or a quick-use slot. Instantly moves the actor to the centre of the scientist bunker on Pripyat Full.
Reusable QA item for double-click or a quick-use slot. Issues the next Chronicles of Pripyat story document in sequence and unlocks its related entry.
Reusable QA item for double-click or a quick-use slot. Issues one copy of every missing Ghost City note directly to the inventory and unlocks their articles. No test stash is created.

Reusable QA item for double-click or a quick-use slot. Using it records the actor position as the next delivery point and immediately creates a closed order dropbox beneath the actor. Its additional context action removes the latest record together with its linked dropbox.

Reusable QA item for double-click or a quick-use slot. Moves the actor to a safe AI point near a random verified interior stash-catalogue position on Pripyat Full. Repeated use selects a new location.

Reusable QA item for double-click or a quick-use slot. Moves the actor to a safe AI point near a random outdoor stash-catalogue position outside interiors on Pripyat Full. Repeated use selects a new location.

Reusable QA item for double-click or a quick-use slot. Records the actor position and camera-facing direction as a marker for a future NPC spawn. Log: $app_data_root$\logs\pf_bunker_qa_npc_points.log.
